data.major_crop_areas: Lower Eastern (Machakos, Makueni, Kitui), parts of Embu (lower zones) and Tharaka Nithi, coastal hinterland (Kilifi, Kwale), and mid-altitude belts of Rift Valley and Western regions including Trans-Nzoia, Uasin Gishu, Bungoma and Kakamega

characteristics.source: Compiled from Kenyan maize extension guidance and water-efficient hybrid briefs (e.g., DroughtTEGO/WE hybrids) by KALRO/AATF, and general KEPHIS/KALRO variety information.

Kenya.crop_suitability_note: Major cultivation location with diverse cultivar options
